rules: Absolute Luxi peak is dual_gemm B72 multi-run median
Matched vLLM comparison is a separate fact (B16/B32 only until B72 vLLM arm)
Do not attach 1.18x vLLM ratio to B72

champion.name: dual_gemm
champion.why_champion: Best energy + near-best thr; five-run stable (no thermal outlier); simpler than dual_fuse; more defensible product recipe

not_champion.name: dual_fuse
not_champion.why_not: Only +0.1% thr vs dual_gemm, slightly worse J/pos, thermal outlier 36783.4; not product crown

vs_prior_absolute_B16_freeze.note: Absolute Luxi peak vs prior Luxi B16 lock — not a vLLM comparison

matched_vllm_status.rule: Do not imply B72 absolute thr is 1.18x vLLM until matched B72 vLLM arm is measured

single_shot_peak_nonclaim.use: engineering peak only — never product headline

receipt_equality_b72.scope: Door_B stack fingerprint under dual_gemm env: B1/B16/B32 hash_stable=true, max_abs_vs_run0=0, cross-process hash equal; thr-shape B72 dual-run thr_rel~0.6% flash fb=0
receipt_equality_b72.note: Fingerprint exercises same TRADE dual_gemm stack path at multiple M; thr loop at B72 does not emit hashes. Door B not Door A bit-exact AUDIT.
receipt_equality_b72.rule: May claim Door-B numeric receipt stability under dual_gemm fingerprint contract; not AUDIT bit-exact hero
